post.title: Would You Wear This Sign? Your Answer Says More Than You Think #shorts
post.description: Yes or no: would you wear the sign? Tell me in the comments. Send this to the friend who says 'everyone does it.' Milo is sure everyone thinks like him. Theo asks him the question from a famous Stanford study. In 1977, Lee Ross, David Greene and Pamela House asked students to walk around campus for 30 minutes wearing a sandwich board that said 'Eat at Joe's'. Then they asked them to guess what other students would do. Students who agreed estimated about 62% of others would agree too; students who refused thought only about 33% would agree. Whatever we pick, we tend to assume most people would pick the same. It's called the false consensus effect (Journal of Experimental Social Psychology, 1977). #psychology #shorts #falseconsensus #overthinking #socialpsychology
